company.name: Poker Fish SAS
company.shortDescription: Poker Fish provides online poker statistics software that profiles opponents and displays real-time HUD data for players.
company.description: Poker Fish offers a statistical analysis platform for online poker players that focuses on profiling opponents and displaying real-time data at the tables. The company provides a Mac and Windows HUD application that shows instant statistics on opponents directly on popular online poker sites. Its service includes detailed player profiles, tournament history, profit and profitability metrics, and performance evolution over time. Users can search tournaments and players, view rankings and leaderboards, and analyze the profitability of specific events. The platform also offers features such as cards-up final table hand history replay, automatic table placement, and username aggregation. Access to data and statistics is delivered through subscription plans that integrate with the desktop application.
